body: Chief: the sibling app repo exists — /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/storyatlas4s (main, unpushed; 4 commits, registered in packages.toml). storyatlas4s-intaglio lowers NarrativeScene and CodexFlow to intaglio scenes with GraphicsName = MarkId / AnnotationId (8 tests, JVM+JS); storyatlas4s-cli 'edition --out' renders the WOG fixture to atlas-{story,episode,scene}.svg/.txt + codex-{reading,overview}.svg/.txt + receipt.json — deterministic (receipt byte-identical across runs; SVG data-name counts equal the receipt). Pins: storymodel4s 8492e43, intaglio 596b398; local builds pass -Dstoryatlas4s.storymodel4s.build/-Dstoryatlas4s.intaglio.build/-Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build. Decisions to review when you have bandwidth (bead filed): Codex lowering takes CodexFlow directly, one named group per annotation until pagination lands (no codex.html yet); AtlasLowering takes discourseLength (scene carries no text); only groups carry names; layer/status/portal mode rendered as text per V-U5; event=circle, state=square; edition state = {Causal, Reference}, ThreadPolicy.All(3), lenses Reading+Overview. Follow-up beads: layout/paginator → codex.html; Laminar app shell.
